source.heading: Meet the paper and its authors
source.altText: The paper’s title page introduces its journal, title and authors before connecting papers with experiments.

route.heading: Follow the paper’s main questions
route.altText: A route connects the problem, proposed systems, existing examples, operating loop, trust and limitations.

card-problem.heading: See what research must connect
card-problem.altText: The route highlights the problem: researchers must connect knowledge across different sources.

spread.heading: Connect knowledge across different sources
spread.altText: Papers, data, theory and experiments surround a researcher and must be brought together.

by-hand.heading: Join knowledge through human judgement
by-hand.altText: A researcher moves between sources, making a succession of judgements.

pipelines.heading: See where fixed pipelines struggle
pipelines.altText: A fixed pipeline and laboratory track cannot readily turn towards a new problem.

llm-wall.heading: Bridge digital tasks and physical experiments
llm-wall.altText: An agent handles search, summaries and code on one side of a dashed boundary; a laboratory instrument stands on the other.

card-proposal.heading: Explore the paper’s proposed system
card-proposal.altText: The route highlights the proposal: agentic systems connect reasoning with action.

joins.heading: Join reasoning, tools and experimental action
joins.altText: An agent connects to papers, data and laboratory equipment through tool calls.

definition.heading: Separate agents, workflow and environment
definition.altText: An agent sits inside an organising workflow, surrounded by data, instruments and people.

tools-today.heading: Steer familiar agents with versioned profiles
tools-today.altText: Named coding agents appear alongside a versioned Markdown profile that supplies their instructions.

assembly.heading: Build from model to ecosystem
assembly.altText: A foundation model gains tools to become an agent; agents form systems within a wider research ecosystem.

card-systems.heading: Look at systems already built
card-systems.altText: The route highlights existing systems and what they have done.

table3.heading: Locate the systems in Table 3
table3.altText: Table 3 presents 18 systems spanning chemistry, materials science and biology.

families.heading: Compare three families of agents
families.altText: Three lanes distinguish cognitive, embodied laboratory and collaborative agents.

lit-mining.heading: Read papers into a structured table
lit-mining.altText: An agent reads papers and fills a table of synthesis conditions: about 800 metal-organic frameworks, with over 90 percent precision.

hypotheses.heading: Rank drug combinations using a knowledge graph
hypotheses.altText: Literature and databases feed a knowledge graph supporting ranked drug-combination hypotheses for a biomarker.

coscientist.heading: Coordinate code, equipment and human help
coscientist.altText: Coscientist searches the web, writes code and controls a liquid handler; a person moves the plates.

crispr.heading: Design experiments in cancer cells
crispr.altText: CRISPR-GPT experiments yield four knockouts in lung adenocarcinoma cells and two activations in melanoma cells.

virtual-lab.heading: Hold a research meeting among agents
virtual-lab.altText: A principal investigator, specialists and a critic collaborate; 92 designed nanobodies lead to two with improved binding.

co-scientist.heading: Nominate targets for liver fibrosis
co-scientist.altText: AI Co-Scientist nominates targets; HDAC and BRD4 inhibitors suppress fibrosis in human liver organoids.

card-loop.heading: Follow the system’s operating loop
card-loop.altText: The route highlights how systems run and revise their work.

loop.heading: Follow tasks through planning and checking
loop.altText: Tasks progress through planning, action, validation and revision, supported by tools, memory and feedback.

checkpoint.heading: Pause for a person’s approval
checkpoint.altText: A consequential decision reaches a human checkpoint; the proposed system pauses if nobody answers.

lnp-setup.heading: Equip an agent for formulation research
lnp-setup.altText: The lipid nanoparticle agent seeks mRNA formulations for melanoma using a lipid catalogue, papers, instructions and scripts.

lnp-lab.heading: Review candidates before laboratory testing
lnp-lab.altText: Researchers review ranked formulations; approved candidates proceed to laboratory testing and results feed back into the process.

card-trust.heading: Decide how much to trust outputs
card-trust.altText: The route highlights the researcher’s judgement of what returned results establish.

outputs.heading: Climb from extraction to experimental confirmation
outputs.altText: A ladder rises through extracted knowledge, ranked hypotheses, refined candidates and experimental confirmation; decisions are recorded.

validation.heading: Check results and repeat the run
validation.altText: Checks progress from internal consistency to computation and wet-lab testing; repeated runs reveal variability.

redirect.heading: See how small changes redirect reasoning
redirect.altText: Changing a prompt, context or tool sends an agent’s reasoning along a different path.

record.heading: Keep the full record of a run
record.altText: A record collects prompts, tools, memory, intermediate steps and human interventions.

report.heading: Record who made each consequential decision
report.altText: A report records who set the goal, chose tools, fixed failures and approved irreversible actions.

card-limits.heading: Identify the failures that remain
card-limits.altText: The route highlights remaining limitations and failures.

errors.heading: Watch small errors accumulate across steps
errors.altText: A chain of steps drifts further from a target line as errors accumulate.

mirage.heading: Question claims about an absent image
mirage.altText: An agent describes an image never supplied, shown as an empty dashed frame.

context.heading: Keep early limits within the model’s context
context.altText: As files fill a context tray, an early constraint falls out while the agent continues answering.

injection.heading: Recognise instructions hidden inside retrieved material
injection.altText: Hidden instructions in a web page, supplementary file and database field enter an agent through retrieved material.

copilots.heading: See where people improve laboratory results
copilots.altText: Protein cost falls by 40 percent in a GPT-5-guided cloud lab; the largest improvement coincides with human intervention. Researcher and agent appear as co-pilots.

close.heading: Set goals and approve consequential actions
close.altText: A researcher sets a goal and approves actions; a recorded trail links work to a discovery.

end.heading: Return to the paper and sources
end.altText: The paper’s title page appears beside its citation and DOI.
